register: du (informal singular, as Swedish health apps and 1177.se use). Straight register: calm, plain, patient-leaflet Swedish using 1177.se terms. Wry register: understated, dry, warm humour; never loud. No exclamation marks. Swedish quotation marks ”…”.
gender: Gender-neutral throughout: Swedish does not mark the user's gender with du. Clinician = 'läkare' (gender-neutral). No hen/hon needed.

glossary.surge: våg (en våg, vågor): '3 vågor', 'Nu kommer en våg', 'Jag har en våg'
glossary.Night Watch: Nattvakt (feature name, capitalised; Siri: 'Slå på Nattvakt i ${applicationName}')
glossary.calm stretch: lugn svit (days in a row without a våg)
glossary.Apple Health: appen Hälsa (Apple's Swedish name 'Hälsa'); standalone label: Apple Hälsa
glossary.Action Button: snabbknappen (verified: Apple sv-se 'Använd och anpassa snabbknappen på iPhone')
glossary.menopause: menopaus (the point, the last period) / klimakteriet (the phase); övergångsåldern in casual copy
glossary.emergency: ring 112 / larmnummer — app inserts number; literal 'räddningstjänst/larmnumret'
